items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Just for documenting purposes, what were your parents’ full names?

Leonard was my dad’s name, Leonard DeFranco, and my mom was Louise Giordano, and her family was from Calabria, her parents. My dad’s parents were from Foggia, which is kind of central Italy. I don’t know how my grandparents got together at all or where they met, but they somehow got to the United States. One of my uncles was born in Italy; he was about a year old when my grandparents came to the United States and settled by mistake in Philadelphia. They were originally going to go to New York and something went…
And your mother’s parents also lived in the U.S?
